newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices fall on rising new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices fall on rising new arrivals.

text.p: Indian soybean prices fell on Monday on rising new season's arrivals with around 100 tonnes coming from central region markets, dealers said.
"Prices may further fall if arrivals increase," said a trader at Indore, a hub of India's soybean industry.

Prices fell by around 550 rupees per tonne in plant delivery condition. Soyoil prices were down on heavy selling from plants and refineries. Soyoil solvent was down by 1,000 rupees and soyoil refined was down by 800 rupees. The undertone was weak.

Soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices were down on limited export demand. Soymeal yellow was $283 per tonne for November-December shipment in new season. There was no trading for current season in ready delivery condition.
Rapeseed extraction was $127 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,350-4,400 rupees FOR (Free on Rail) Bedibunder and was 4,325-4,350 rupees FOR Bhavnagar.
